business_summary: Eiwa Corporation offers industrial measurement, and control equipment, environmental measurement and analysis equipment, measurement and inspection equipment, industrial machinery in Japan. It offers industrial instruments, such as level, pressure, temperature and humidity, load, rotation, torque, current, voltage, power measurement equipment, and flow rate measurement, as well as temperature measurement; and control equipment, including factory automation sensors, information and communication devices, control system equipment, and receiving device. The company also provides environmental measurement and analysis equipment; pumps, valves, hydraulic and pneumatic equipment; and pressure measurement, inspection equipment and material measurement, and non-destructive testing equipment. In addition, it offers industrial equipment, including security equipment, environmental improvement equipment, manufacturing equipment, energy, and waste disposal/recycled equipment; and Industrial vehicles. Further, the company provides focused solutions, such as digital transformation, green transformation, and social infrastructure development. It serves petrochemical/functional materials, steel, non-ferrous metals, electric power, shipbuilding, car industries, as well as local governments and government agencies. The company was formerly known as Eiwa Seiko Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Eiwa Corporation in 1987. Eiwa Corporation was founded in 1947 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Eiwa Corporation은 일본의 산업용 측정 및 제어 장비, 환경 측정 및 분석 장비, 측정 및 검사 장비, 산업 기계를 제공합니다. 레벨, 압력, 온도 및 습도, 부하, 회전, 토크, 전류, 전압, 전력 측정 장비, 유량 측정 및 온도 측정과 같은 산업용 계측기를 제공합니다. 공장자동화 센서, 정보통신기기, 제어시스템 장비, 수신장치 등 제어장비 등을 포함한다. 이 회사는 또한 환경 측정 및 분석 장비를 제공합니다. 펌프, 밸브, 유압 및 공압 장비; 압력 측정, 검사 장비 및 재료 측정, 비파괴 테스트 장비. 또한 보안 장비, 환경 개선 장비, 제조 장비, 에너지, 폐기물 처리/재활용 장비 등 산업 장비를 제공합니다. 및 산업용 차량. 또한 디지털 트랜스포메이션, 그린 트랜스포메이션, 사회 인프라 개발 등 집중적인 솔루션을 제공하고 있습니다. 석유화학/기능성 소재, 철강, 철강 등을 서비스하고 있습니다.
